dataset_name: Japan Sightseeing and City Attraction Dataset
purpose: Multi-city sightseeing dataset for a travel-planning, route-selection or itinerary-optimization project.
compatibility_note: The uploaded file used a single-city root object. This master file uses a top-level cities array; update the loader to iterate over data["cities"] and then each city["places"]. Original place fields (name, lat, lon, attraction, souvenir, duration_min, open, close, effort, tags) are retained.

included_activity_policy.note: Food markets and ordinary family-friendly shopping districts are included. Adult-oriented entertainment venues are not included.

attraction.meaning: Editorial estimate of general sightseeing interest, not a public rating or popularity metric.

souvenir.meaning: Estimated usefulness of the location for finding souvenirs, local crafts or specialty shopping. Not a quality score.

effort.meaning: Approximate physical effort for a typical visit. Terrain, weather, crowds and route choices can change it.

planning_data_policy.opening_hours: The open and close fields are broad planning windows, not live schedules. Many places have seasonal hours, last-entry cutoffs, weekly closures, event restrictions or separate hours for different buildings. Check official pages before relying on them.
planning_data_policy.coordinates: Coordinates are approximate map pins (WGS84). They are suitable for rough plotting and route prototypes, not turn-by-turn navigation or precise geofencing.
planning_data_policy.duration: duration_min is an estimated visit duration excluding travel between places, waiting, meals and transit transfers.
planning_data_policy.fees: admission_fee_jpy is null when a stable current fee was not encoded. Prices may differ by age, exhibition, season or ticket type.
planning_data_policy.scores: Scores are heuristic project inputs and should be tuned or replaced using your own criteria or user testing.
planning_data_policy.regional_day_trips: Some famous locations are outside the named city boundary but commonly visited from that city. These are marked location_scope=nearby_day_trip and include their municipality.
